DIAGNOSIS READY: Acute Hepatitis (likely viral or toxin-induced) with signs of liver failure.

The lab results show significantly elevated bilirubin (25 mg/dL) and transaminases (AST/ALT >600 IU/L) alongside a reduced PT activity and elevated INR, which confirms severe hepatic dysfunction inconsistent with appendicitis. Given your history of substance use and high-risk sexual behavior, we must treat this as an acute liver injury until viral or toxic causes are ruled out.
